title: Replay for LLM Continual Learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02746v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills several domain experts into one student and is used in the post-training of recent large language models. It trains on all domains at once, so every expert must be available at the same time. In practice, capabilities often arrive one after another, and the experts of earlier domains may be gone when a new domain is learned. Distilling the experts in sequence then suffers from catastrophic forgetting of the earlier domains. Some recent pipelines store a snapshot after every stage and end with a multi-teacher recovery stage taught by all snapshots. The number of stored models then grows with the number of stages. Different from these pipelines, this paper formulates continual MOPD by what is kept from earlier stages and studies replay toward the previous student. translated_title: 基于多教师在线策略蒸馏重放的LLM持续学习
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将多个领域专家蒸馏到一个学生模型中，被用于近期大型语言模型的后训练。它同时对所有领域进行训练，因此每个专家模型必须同时可用。但在实践中，各种能力往往是陆续出现的，当学习新领域时，早期领域的专家模型可能已经不复存在。按顺序蒸馏这些专家模型会导致对早期领域的灾难性遗忘。一些近期的流水线在每个阶段之后存储一个快照，最后以由所有快照进行教学的多教师恢复阶段收尾，但这样存储的模型数量会随阶段数量不断增长。与这些流水线不同，本文通过从早期阶段保留什么来形式化持续MOPD，并研究向先前学生模型的重放方法。在每个阶段内部，早期领域的提示以之前阶段的学生模型作为教师进行重放，从而无需（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出持续多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，在每个训练阶段以上一阶段的学生模型作为教师重放早期领域的提示，从而无需同时保留所有领域专家模型或存储大量快照即可缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates continual multi-teacher on-policy distillation by replaying prompts of earlier domains with the previous stage's student as their teacher, mitigating catastrophic forgetting without requiring all domain experts to be available simultaneously or storing numerous model snapshots.
